text:
Maya: Heads-up — EmberHealth QBR scheduled for next Tue. We need a concise token/spend forecast and any onboarding blockers to present to their finance lead.
Jon: Got it. I can pull the last 30d usage and run a 3-week projection. Noticed a few heavy embed jobs last week.
Priya: quick numbers from my side: `current month tokens = 120M`, `running rate = ~4M/day`, projected 3w spike = `+35%` if activation continues.
Amir: Re: mitigation — recommend temp burst credits + per-route throttles on embedding endpoint. Also suggest prompt-level guidance for their devs.
FinOps-Bot: alert: EmberHealth retainer usage at 78% this billing period — auto-notify pending.
Maya: Thanks. Renewal tone? Are they at risk if we don't propose a commit increase?
Priya: Renewal risk = low/medium. Product usage healthy, but if spike sustains they'll hit overage alerts and finance will push back.
Jon: For the QBR deck I'll include: runway (tokens left), ask (commit bump or throttle), enablement plan, and a small appendix with per-route latency/cost. Need CS to confirm exact ask language.
Maya: Proposed ask: "Recommend 10% retainer uplift for next quarter to cover burst, plus a short enablement session to optimize prompts." Thoughts?
Amir: That's reasonable. I provisioned temporary credits: `50k credits | expires in 14d` to avoid immediate overages. Left a note in the account. :thumbsup:
Priya: Could we also add a quick customer feedback capture in the QBR — two questions about latency vs. cost tradeoffs? That'll help justify the ask.
Jon: Good call. I'll add a slide with their usage patterns and a single-slide cost/latency tradeoff visualization. Can someone pull per-route P95 latency for the last 14d?
Maya: @Jon I have permission to pull Console traces, will export P95 and token distribution by route and drop into the deck.
Amir: Also recommend a checklist for SEs: 1) reduce high-temperature loops, 2) enable prefix caching, 3) move heavy batch jobs to off-peak. Shareable in the enablement session.
FinOps-Bot: note: exported invoices available at /billing/emberhealth/2026-03.
Maya: Action items summary: 
- Jon: deck + forecast slides (due EOD Fri)
- Priya: confirm renewal risk blurb + feedback survey questions
- Amir: confirm credits provisioned (done) and provide SE checklist
- Maya: schedule enablement call and invite EmberHealth PM + finance lead
Jon: will draft slides and ping for review.
Priya: will draft two feedback q's and post them here for quick edits.
Maya: thanks all — keeping this thread as the canonical QBR ops thread. Ping me if anything changes. :eyes:
